title: Every eligible seed utility, CY2025Q1 against CY2024Q1: one cold run each through the agent
measured: 2026-10-25 23:04 to 2026-10-26 00:25 (SGT), live stack: local Zetaris through the gateway, Ollama nemotron-3-nano:4b with the shipped settings (planner think on), code at d2f207d
command: cd agent && npm run ask -- --cik <cik10> --period CY2025Q1 --claim "the weather"
eligibility: A seed is eligible when the agent can build its like-for-like change: a CY2025Q1 frames fact under one of the three revenue tags (what probe_revenue_tag looks for) and a CY2024Q1 fact under that same tag (the rule the peer set applies to every peer). Every seed has station rows (eval-report section 3). Measured through the gateway's frames_seeds template on 25 Oct 2026: 41 of 43 eligible. IDACORP (no CY2025Q1 fact under any tag) and Oncor (no CY2024Q1 fact under its tag) are not; both were run anyway, last, as controls, and are listed with eligible=false outside the distribution.
note: One fresh data directory holding only the DQ onboarding file, runs in seed-file order, each the utility's first run (cold). Ten companyconcept tables existed from onboarding; for every other target the agent registered its own companyconcept table at run time through the gateway's registrar (register_concept, a signed medium-risk contract). The claim is the default "the weather": these filings were not read by hand, so no management wording is quoted and a verdict is about the split, not about a sentence a utility wrote. Revenue levels and filing text are left out (SEC values are queried live, not redistributed); growth, degree days and the split are percentages from the card. A video re-cut ran ffmpeg on the same machine during part of the sweep (machine.ffmpeg_running_before_after), which can lengthen wall times.

labels.percentages: measured, from each run's card (1 decimal)
labels.ranges: weather, industry and beta: 10th to 90th percentile of 300 bootstrap resamples, seed 7; remainder: the change minus the weather and industry bounds
